name: Datatype · Datatype

title.zh: Datatype · 把文本表达式排成行内小图表

description.zh: 改完轴值和字号，看柱形字样怎样在当前设置下呈现。 利用OpenType连字将特定文本表达式显示为柱形、折线和饼图的可变字体，官网提供类型对照、变轴预览和行内案例。字体软件及字体源文件适用OFL-1.1，价格未核实；制作脚本和整仓库的代码许可另行核对。
description.en: A variable OpenType font that renders specific text expressions as bars, sparklines and pies. Its site shows syntax comparisons, variable-axis previews and inline examples. Font software and font sources use OFL-1.1; pricing remains unverified. Build scripts and the complete repository require separate license checks.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Datatype (https://franktisellano.github.io/datatype/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 改完轴值和字号，看柱形字样怎样在当前设置下呈现。

Visual details from source observation: 我们在首页看到的柱形、折线和饼图，其实都来自同一个字体。先看图表下的文本表达式，再到可变轴区改宽度、字重和字号，很容易把参数与形状对上，适合在表格或正文里放短小图表。它交付的是字体文件，不需要另接绘图库；使用与再分发须守字体的OFL条件，制作脚本及第三方内容的权利另核，别把一个声明套到整仓库。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
